full_details: On the walk north the Bedlam gate stood open. The wicket-hasp was wrenched. A cap lay in the road. Backs were running north. You saw that, and not a man being brought out. A water-bearer said apprentices had fetched a silkweaver out of the hospital, and that the talk was the Lord Mayor had put him in for words at his door about the dearth. He said that part was talk he had not stood at the door to hear. You did not treat it as known. At the Theatre Margery Pell already had a figure, two hundred. Cowley had one account and Larkham another. They agreed only that people had been running toward the noise. Cowley wanted to go down and see which story was true. You would not. Rehearsal of Richard the Third started with the street still in everyone's ears, and you kept the scene in the house. At two you played. The plot named you as a player and named no author. At supper Verbeke had it from the looms: a silkweaver, like himself, and English. He said so it is not yet us, and he cut his bread smaller. Mistress Ansell and Alse were at the table. You did not go back to the gate.
one_sentence: You saw the Bedlam gate open and the running, and at supper heard Verbeke say it is not yet us.
title: The Bedlam gate standing open
